CONTACT + TENSION +

OFF · CURRENT CLEAN CROSSING CLEARANCE

NEARBY UNDERPASSES RESTRAIN EACH SPAN. HIGHER TENSION KEEPS CLEARANCE TIGHT; ADAPTIVE RESPONSE USES CONTACT SPACING, CROSSING ANGLE, CURVATURE, AND ADJACENT RESTRAINTS. MOVING EITHER SLIDER ENABLES THE RESPONSE. LOWER BASE VALUES PRODUCE LONGER, CLEARLY VISIBLE CLEARANCE; ADAPTIVE RESPONSE TIGHTENS CROWDED OR CURVED SPANS. CERTIFIED THREAD PATHS DO NOT MOVE.

OFF

CONTINUOUS THREADS PASS BEHIND THE UPPER RIBBON; NO CUT-END GAPS. CLICK A MARK TO SELECT IT, THEN CHOOSE ITS UPPER THREAD OR SWAP IT. MANUAL OVERRIDES REMAIN ABOVE THE ACTIVE MODE. CONTACTS AND AMBIGUOUS MEETINGS STAY UNWOVEN. CHANGING GEOMETRY MAKES LOCAL OVERRIDES INACTIVE.

EXPORT WEAVE DRAWING

CENTERLINES EXPORT ONE OPEN PATH PER STRAND FRAGMENT WITH STABLE FAMILY AND STRAND IDENTITIES. FULL WEAVE PRESERVES OUTLINES, HIERARCHY, OPACITY, ENDS, AND OVER / UNDER.

VECTOR LINES ONLY · NO PAINTED BACKGROUND. PDF PRESERVES SAVED LINE WEIGHTS, OPACITY, HIERARCHY, ENDS, AND OVER / UNDER GAPS. WHITE LINES MAY APPEAR BLANK ON A WHITE VIEWER PAGE.

RASTERIZED FROM THE CERTIFIED VECTOR LINEWORK, NEVER FROM THE SCREEN. THE CURRENT APPLIED WEAVE AND CHOSEN SOURCE OR DISTORTED LAYER ARE TIGHTLY BOUNDED, CENTERED, AND PADDED ON A FULLY TRANSPARENT CANVAS. AN ISOLATED FAMILY EXPORTS BY ITSELF. LINE WEIGHTS, OPACITY, HIERARCHY, ENDS, AND OVER / UNDER GAPS ARE PRESERVED.
